release.title: The Glass Wardens
release.description: Guide three glass wardens through deterministic tactical card battles, five branching expedition steps and a two-phase lighthouse boss. EN/FR/ES, touch controls and exact local save.
controls: Click or tap a hero or card, then a highlighted target; review and confirm or cancel.
Each hero moves once; spend three shared energy, then end turn.
Escape cancels, Space ends turn, M toggles sound.
credits: Designed and developed with Kimi for Kimi Games from Cédric's creative mission.
Original SVG glass figurines, card symbols, interface, cover art, animation and synthesized audio created for this game.
No third-party runtime libraries, remote assets or external services.

Kimi — Created the tactical engine, ten-card deck, distinct enemy behaviors, branching expedition, two-phase boss, exact seeded save, original SVG and cover artwork, synthesized audio, trilingual interface and browser verification for Kimi Games.

limitations: File scans and a bounded JavaScript policy do not certify that a game is free of vulnerabilities.
The browser test checks startup and a few inputs, not all possible game behavior.

staticAnalysis.coverage: A bounded local rule set, not a proof that code is free of vulnerabilities.
